title: The Cardinalities of Intervals of Equational Theories and Logics
summary: We study the cardinality of classes of equational theories (varieties) and logics by applying descriptive set theory. We affirmatively solve open problems raised by Jackson and Lee [Trans. Am. Math. Soc. 370 (2018), pp. 4785-4812] regarding the cardinalities of subvariety lattices, and by Bezhanishvili et al. [J. Math. Log. (2025), in press] regarding the degrees of the finite model property (fmp).
